snippet.title: Updated Look at our Indie Co-op Museum Game
snippet.description:
We're a small team of 3 devs starting our indie journey! Smithonion Natural History Museum is a quick, fun, and chaotic co-op game where you work the night shift at a museum that's coming alive around you. Wishlist it on Steam to support us: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4541970/Smithonion_Natural_History_Museum/

Music: ♪ stream cafe - boba date
